pages.title: How to play
pages.text: Choose Low (1–5) or High (6–10), adjust your stake with the buttons, then Start. Settlement is automatic when the number stops.

pages.title: Event probabilities
pages.text: Each round independently draws 1–10; each number has a 10% chance. High and Low each win 50%.$(br2)Correct: ×1.8. Wrong: ×0. Losing streaks do not improve the next chance.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: Default Lv.1; initial stake cap 2,000. Wallet upgrades can raise it.$(br2)The result settles automatically once.$(br2)Payouts include the stake. Server rules may differ; check the live interface.
Craft, then right-click to use. Machines still require the matching wallet level.
